title: Constance Wu 吳恬敏
content_html:
Constance Wu is an American actress born on March 22, 1982, in Richmond, Virginia, to Taiwanese immigrant parents. In 2005, she earned a B.F.A. in Acting from the State University of New York at Purchase and built her early career in theater before transitioning to television and film.

Wu came to national prominence with her portrayal of Jessica Huang in the ABC sitcom Fresh Off the Boat (2015–2020), one of the first network sitcoms in over two decades to center an Asian American family. Her performance earned a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress in a Comedy Series.

In 2018, Wu starred as Rachel Chu in Crazy Rich Asians, the first Hollywood studio film in 25 years to feature a predominantly Asian cast. The film grossed over $238 million worldwide against a $30 million budget and was nominated for a SAG Award for Outstanding Cast in a Motion Picture.

In 2022, Wu published Making a Scene, a memoir addressing her experiences in the entertainment industry. She was named one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential People in 2018.

Constance Wu is an American actress born on March 22, 1982, in Richmond, Virginia, to Taiwanese immigrant parents. In 2005, she earned a B.F.A. in Acting from the State University of New York at Purchase and built her early career in theater before transitioning to television and film.

Wu came to national prominence with her portrayal of Jessica Huang in the ABC sitcom Fresh Off the Boat (2015–2020), one of the first network sitcoms in over two decades to center an Asian American family. Her performance earned a Golden Globe nomination for Best Actress in a Comedy Series.

In 2018, Wu starred as Rachel Chu in Crazy Rich Asians, the first Hollywood studio film in 25 years to feature a predominantly Asian cast. The film grossed over $238 million worldwide against a $30 million budget and was nominated for a SAG Award for Outstanding Cast in a Motion Picture.

In 2022, Wu published Making a Scene, a memoir addressing her experiences in the entertainment industry. She was named one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential People in 2018.
